entries.resolution: src/creatures/monsters/monsters.cpp deserializeSpell sets COMBAT_PARAM_BLOCKARMOR and COMBAT_PARAM_BLOCKSHIELD on a monster melee, so its damage is reduced by the target armor and shield defense (mitigated_by). Melee chance normalized to 100: monsters.cpp deserializeSpell: melee is scheduled by interval; the declared chance is not applied.

Damage/heal magnitude comes from this monster entry: combat.cpp Combat::getCombatDamage uses Monster::getCombatValues (D11); the script formula applies only to players.

Corpse and its decay chain are local capability projections from appearances.dat + items.xml; items.cpp: blockSolid=unpass, blockProjectile=unsight, blockPathFind=avoid, pickupable=take, movable=!unmove. Weight absent in items.xml is the engine default 0. Duration seconds -> ms.
